Method of Attack: Exploitation of CVE-2023-27532 vulnerability to access encrypted credentials and execute remote code with highest privileges
Execution of PowerShell scripts for payload delivery and lateral movement
Use of backdoors (DiceLoader/Tirion and PowerPlant) for persistence and control
Credential theft from Veeam backup database
Lateral movement using stolen credentials via SMB protocol and WMI invocations
Attack Vector: Unsecured API endpoint exploitation in Veeam Backup and Replication software
Public web accessible Veeam Backup and Replication servers
Open TCP port 9401 on compromised servers
Indicators of Compromise: Suspicious alerts such as sqlservr.exe spawning cmd.exe and downloading PowerShell scripts
Use of custom PowerShell scripts for reconnaissance and lateral movement
SMB communication protocol usage to drop PowerShell scripts onto administrative shares
